page_title: Amsterdam Flame Marijuana Strain - Kind Green Buds

source_page_metadata.description: Explore the Amsterdam Flame marijuana strain - THC levels, genetics, terpene profile, effects, flavor, and grow tips.

article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Indica-Dominant Hybrid
Genetics: White Widow × Afghani
Breeder: Dutch Passion
THC Content: 18–24%
CBD Content: Low (typically under 1%)
Terpene Profile: Myrcene , Caryophyllene , Pinene
Primary Flavors: Earthy, Sweet, Pine, Spicy
Flowering Time (Indoor): 8–9 weeks
Outdoor Harvest Time: Late September to Early October
Indoor Yield: 14–18 oz per m²
Outdoor Yield: 18–22 oz per plant
Grow Difficulty: Easy to Moderate

Certain cannabis strains evoke a sense of place through their genetics and character. Amsterdam Flame reflects the old-school Dutch breeding traditions that helped shape modern marijuana culture . Developed by Dutch Passion, the cultivar blends the resin-rich power of White Widow with the earthy depth of Afghan genetics, resulting in a hybrid that carries the unmistakable signature of classic European cannabis breeding .

Rather than relying on flashy terpene extremes or overwhelming potency, this plant delivers a balanced experience built on reliability and rich aroma. Thick resin production, dense buds, and a calming body high give the strain a traditional indica feel. For cannabis enthusiasts who appreciate cultivars rooted in early Amsterdam coffee shop history , this hybrid represents a continuation of the genetic legacy that made the Dutch cannabis scene famous.
Genetics and Lineage

Amsterdam Flame traces its lineage to two historically significant cannabis parents: White Widow and an Afghan landrace-derived indica. The strain was produced by Dutch Passion, one of the earliest cannabis seed companies to popularize stabilized hybrid genetics in Europe. Their breeding work often focused on combining potent resin production with manageable growth patterns.

White Widow provides a large portion of the strain’s identity . Originally developed in the Netherlands during the 1990s, White Widow became internationally recognized for its heavy trichome coverage and balanced effects. The parent contributes strong resin production, moderate potency, and a subtle sweetness within the terpene profile. Many descendants of this famous hybrid inherit its frosty bud structure and slightly uplifting mental tone.

The Afghan lineage contributes depth and physical relaxation. Afghani cannabis plants are known for dense flowers, earthy aromas, and powerful body effects. When combined with White Widow, these genetics create a hybrid that maintains resin density while introducing a heavier, more tranquil physical sensation. The resulting plant carries the best traits of both parents: resin-rich buds and a calm, grounded high.
Effects and Experience

The experience begins with a gentle mental lift rather than an immediate sedative wave. After inhalation, many individuals notice a soft sense of euphoria accompanied by a calm mental atmosphere. Thoughts feel steady and unhurried, allowing the mind to relax without losing awareness.

As the high continues to develop, physical relaxation gradually becomes more prominent. Muscles begin to loosen and the body feels comfortably heavy, creating a sensation often described as warm and grounding. Unlike more intense indica varieties that quickly induce sleepiness, this hybrid often settles into a balanced middle ground between calmness and gentle contentment.

Later in the experience, the calming influence deepens. Some cannabis consumers find themselves drawn toward quiet activities such as listening to music, watching films, or simply resting. Because of this gradual progression from mild mental uplift to deeper body relaxation, the cultivar is frequently enjoyed during evenings when the goal is to unwind rather than remain highly active.
Medical Benefits

The calming nature of Amsterdam Flame has led many patients to explore its potential therapeutic applications. The physical relaxation produced by the strain may help ease muscle tension that builds up after long periods of physical activity or stress. The slow onset of the body effects allows individuals to remain comfortable without feeling abruptly sedated.

Stress relief represents another area where the cultivar may offer support. As the high progresses, mental agitation often softens and the body begins to settle into a calmer rhythm. This shift can help people disengage from racing thoughts or persistent worry. Many individuals who use cannabis for relaxation appreciate strains that encourage a peaceful mental environment without overwhelming intoxication.

Even though the plant leans toward physical effects, some patients also turn to similar indica hybrids when addressing sleep difficulties. As the experience reaches its later stages, the tranquil body sensation can make rest feel more natural. For individuals incorporating medical marijuana into evening routines, strains with this type of soothing profile can be particularly useful.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

The aroma of Amsterdam Flame reflects its Afghan heritage combined with the subtle sweetness of White Widow. Opening a jar of properly cured buds releases a rich blend of earthy spice and pine resin. Beneath those dominant notes lies a faint herbal sweetness that softens the overall scent.

When the flowers are broken apart, additional layers of fragrance emerge. Myrcene contributes the deep earthy base often associated with traditional indica strains , while caryophyllene introduces peppery spice. Pinene provides a fresh evergreen note that brightens the aroma, preventing it from becoming overly heavy.

The flavor profile closely mirrors the scent. On the inhale, many people notice hash-like earthiness mixed with subtle herbal sweetness. As the smoke leaves the palate, peppery spice and pine become more noticeable. The overall taste feels rich and traditional, reminiscent of classic cannabis varieties that emphasize depth rather than fruit-forward sweetness.
Growing Information

Amsterdam Flame tends to display growth characteristics typical of indica-dominant plants. The plant usually develops a compact structure with thick stems and dense branching. Because of its relatively short stature, it adapts well to indoor cultivation environments where vertical space may be limited.

Flowering generally finishes within eight to nine weeks. During this stage, buds begin forming dense clusters along the branches, gradually becoming coated in resin. By the final weeks of flowering, the plant produces a strong aroma of earthy pine and spice that becomes more pronounced as harvest approaches.

For cultivators planning to grow marijuana , maintaining steady environmental conditions will help maximize quality and yield. Moderate humidity levels and strong airflow help protect the dense buds from moisture-related issues. When grown properly, the plant produces thick flowers with impressive trichome coverage, making it visually striking as well as aromatic.
FAQ
What strain is Amsterdam Flame? Amsterdam Flame is an indica-dominant hybrid bred by Dutch Passion. It combines White Widow genetics with an Afghan-derived indica lineage.

How strong is Amsterdam Flame? THC levels typically range between 17% and 21%. While not among the most potent cannabis strains available, the balanced genetics provide noticeable relaxation and moderate euphoria.
What does Amsterdam Flame taste like? The flavor profile features earthy hash notes, pine, and peppery spice with a faint herbal sweetness that lingers after exhaling.
Is Amsterdam Flame good for nighttime use? Yes. Because of its relaxing body effects, many people prefer enjoying this cultivar during the evening when unwinding and relaxation are desired.

How long does the Amsterdam Flame high last? The effects usually last between two and three hours. The experience often begins with mild mental uplift before transitioning into deeper physical relaxation.
Final Thoughts on Amsterdam Flame

Amsterdam Flame captures the spirit of traditional Dutch cannabis breeding. By combining White Widow’s resin-rich potency with the grounding qualities of Afghan genetics, breeders created a cultivar that emphasizes stability, aroma, and relaxation rather than novelty alone.

One of the strain’s most appealing qualities lies in the gradual progression of its effects. The high moves from gentle euphoria toward deeper body calm, offering a balanced experience suitable for winding down after a busy day. Cannabis enthusiasts who prefer relaxing weed without overwhelming sedation often find this type of hybrid particularly enjoyable.

Equally noteworthy is the plant’s aromatic character. Earthy spice, pine, and subtle herbal sweetness create a terpene profile reminiscent of classic marijuana varieties that helped define early coffee shop culture in Amsterdam.

For growers, the cultivar offers dependable growth patterns and dense resinous buds, reflecting the strength of its Afghan lineage. Taken together, these traits explain why Amsterdam Flame remains an appealing option for those who appreciate traditional cannabis genetics combined with reliable performance and soothing effects.
